title: Design A Leaderboard
summary: Design a leaderboard: addScore adds to a player's score (creating the player if needed), top(K) returns the sum of the K largest scores, and reset sets a player's score back to zero so later additions start afresh.
inputFormat: addScore takes playerId and score; top takes K; reset takes playerId.
outputFormat: top returns an integer sum; addScore and reset return nothing.
edgeRules: Whether K can exceed the number of players, and whether reset of an unknown player is valid, are not recorded.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.input: addScore(1,73), addScore(2,56), addScore(3,39), top(2)? after reset(1), addScore(2,51), top(2)
examples.note: Authored; conditional on K not exceeding players.

factsMissing: Whether K is guaranteed not to exceed the number of players
Whether reset of an unseen player is valid
questions: Is K guaranteed to be no larger than the number of players, and is reset called only for players that exist?
